title: Reject invalid milestone assignments
preconditions: A disposable Saga has two features and a shared Launch milestone.

steps.action: Attempt to assign a nonexistent milestone and compare the feature plan bytes.
steps.expected_result: The request fails and the plan is unchanged.

steps.action: Attempt to assign a milestone URN owned by another Saga and compare the plan bytes.
steps.expected_result: The cross-Saga request is refused without changing the plan.
